why: Files outside src/modules/kb/ that read the kb_pages table directly. This list may only SHRINK. Each entry re-derives the Document visibility rule for itself, which is how six independent ACL implementations came to exist. Port a caller onto the canonical scope in kb/core/authorization/knowledge-page-scope.ts and delete its line.

permanentlyExempt.src/modules/billing/core/plan-limits.ser: Plan-limit counting is tenant-wide by design: COUNT(*) FROM kb_pages WHERE org_id AND deleted_at IS NULL. Applying a visibility predicate would make the limit depend on who asked, so two admins would see different usage for one org and a low-visibility actor could evade the cap. Do not 'fix' this into using the port. It does re-derive the soft-delete predicate by hand, which is the one real cost of the exemption.
